cmsy_run(): 用FAO渔获数据运行CMSY++

Source: vignettes/articles/zh/reference/cmsy_run.Rmd
cmsy_run.Rmd

英文原页：cmsy_run()

说明

本函数对cmsy_input()准备好的种群运行本包附带的CMSY++代码（CMSY++16.R，2021年1月版，见cmsy_sources()），并汇总结果：最大可持续产量（MSY）、Bmsy和Fmsy，每年的相对资源量（B/Bmsy）和相对捕捞死亡率（F/Fmsy）及其95%置信限，最后一年各Kobe象限的概率，以及每个种群的状态。

English

This function runs the CMSY++ code bundled with the package (CMSY++16.R, January 2021, see cmsy_sources()) on the stocks prepared by cmsy_input(), and collects the results: MSY, Bmsy and Fmsy, relative stock size (B/Bmsy) and exploitation (F/Fmsy) in every year with their 95% confidence limits, the probability of each Kobe quadrant in the last year, and the status of each stock.

用法 

cmsy_run(
  input,
  stocks = NULL,
  out_dir = "cmsy",
  parallel = NULL,
  plots = c("analysis", "management", "kobe"),
  os = "auto",
  device = c("file", "screen"),
  seed = NULL,
  auto_start = FALSE,
  settings = list(),
  table = TRUE,
  lang = NULL,
  silent = fao_setting("silent"),
  timeout = 3600
)

参数

input
cmsy_input()的结果。
English The result of cmsy_input().
stocks
要运行的种群（可选）：Stock标识（例如”PIL_34”），或物种的FAO英文或中文名称、学名或FAO三字母代码（运行该物种的所有种群）。默认为NULL，即input中的所有种群。
English Optional stocks to run: Stock identifiers (e.g. “PIL_34”) or species, by English or Chinese FAO name, scientific name or FAO 3-alpha code (all stocks of the species). Default is NULL, all stocks of input.
out_dir
CMSY++输出的文件夹。默认为工作目录下的”cmsy”。
English The folder for the CMSY++ output. Default is “cmsy” in the working directory.
parallel
同时运行的种群数。每个种群还要为其两条MCMC链另外使用两个进程。默认为处理器核心数的一半。
English The number of stocks run at the same time. Each uses two more processes for its two MCMC chains. Default is half the number of processor cores.
plots
要保存为JPEG文件的CMSY++图表：“analysis”、“management”、“kobe”、“prior_posterior”和”retrospective”中的任意几项。默认为前三项。
English The CMSY++ charts to save as JPEG files: any of “analysis”, “management”, “kobe”, “prior_posterior” and “retrospective”. Default is the first three.
os
采用哪个操作系统的设置：“auto”（默认，自动检测）、“windows”、“macos”或”linux”。
English The operating system whose settings are used: “auto” (default, detect it), “windows”, “macos” or “linux”.
device
CMSY++在将图表保存为JPEG文件之前绘图所用的设备：“file”（默认），一种屏幕外图形设备，在所有系统上和批处理运行中都可用；或”screen”，即系统自身的图形窗口（windows()、quartz()或x11()）。
English Where CMSY++ draws its charts before saving them as JPEG files: “file” (default), an off-screen device that works on every system and in batch runs, or “screen”, the system’s own window (windows(), quartz() or x11()).
seed
随机数种子（可选），使运行可以重复并得到相同的结果。
English Optional random seed, so runs can be repeated with the same results.
auto_start
逻辑值。当前三年的平均（平滑）渔获量低于最大值的三分之一、起始年份早于2000年且没有给出起始B/k先验时，CMSY++会警告起始生物量不明确（已衰减还是尚未开发），并建议从渔获量至少达到最大值40%的第一年开始（报告在suggested_start_year中）。为TRUE时，种群从该年开始。CMSY++自身的相应设置（auto.start）在CMSY++16.R中会报错停止（年份范围不再与渔获量年份一致），因此本函数在运行前将同样的规则应用于StartYear。默认为FALSE，与CMSY++相同；用户指南更推荐在cmsy_input()中设定StartYear或起始B/k先验（stb.low、stb.hi）。
English A logical value. When the mean (smoothed) catch of the first three years is below a third of the maximum, the start year is before 2000 and no start B/k prior is given, CMSY++ warns that the start biomass is ambiguous (depleted or unexploited) and suggests starting in the first year with at least 40% of the maximum catch (reported in suggested_start_year). If TRUE, the stock starts in that year. CMSY++’s own setting for this (auto.start) stops with an error in CMSY++16.R (the year range no longer matches the catch years), so the same rule is applied here to StartYear before the run. Default is FALSE, as in CMSY++; the user guide prefers setting StartYear or the start B/k prior (stb.low, stb.hi) in cmsy_input().
settings
可选的命名列表，给出用于替代CMSY++默认值的设置，例如list(sigmaR = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000)。各项设置、其默认值和作用见cmsy_defaults()。默认为不作更改：CMSY++使用其自身的默认值运行。所用的设置保存在运行文件夹的settings_used.csv和result$settings中。
English Optional named list of CMSY++ settings that replace its defaults, e.g. list(sigmaR = 0.2, n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000). See cmsy_defaults() for the settings, their defaults and what they do. Default is no change: CMSY++ runs with its own defaults. The settings used are saved in settings_used.csv of the run folder and in result$settings.
table
逻辑值。为TRUE（默认）时，表格保存在tables/。
English A logical value. If TRUE (default), tables are saved in tables/.
lang
图表文字和名称的语言：“en”（英文）、“zh”（中文）或”both”（中英双语）。默认为NULL，即使用fao_settings()设置的语言（未更改时为”en”）。
English The language of the chart text and names: “en” (English), “zh” (Chinese) or “both” (Chinese and English). Default is NULL, which uses the language set with fao_settings() (“en” unless changed).
silent
逻辑值。为FALSE（默认）时，用进度条显示已完成的种群数以及已用时间和预计剩余时间，并输出运行信息；为TRUE时不输出任何内容。可以用fao_settings(silent = TRUE)更改本次R会话的默认值。
English A logical value. If FALSE (default), a progress bar shows how many stocks have finished, with the elapsed and the estimated remaining time, and messages report the run. If TRUE, nothing is printed. The default can be changed for the session with fao_settings(silent = TRUE).
timeout
单个种群的最长运行时间，单位为秒；超过该时间仍在运行的种群报告为失败。默认为3600。
English Maximum time for one stock, in seconds; a stock still running after it is reported as failed. Default is 3600.

返回值

以不可见方式返回一个cmsy_result类的列表，包含summary（每个种群一行：生物学参考点、最后一年的状态及其95%置信限、Kobe象限概率、所用的先验及其来源链接）、series（逐年：渔获量、预测渔获量、B/k、生物量、B/Bmsy、F和F/Fmsy，以及95%置信限）、kobe（最后一年的后验抽样值）、details（每个种群：r、k和B/k的后验抽样值、先验、回顾性分析的各次运行）、logs、sources（CMSY++、JAGS、R和数据的版本）和changes（对CMSY++代码所做的修改）。汇总表保存在tables/cmsy/。

English

Invisibly, a list of class cmsy_result with summary (one row per stock: reference points, last-year status with 95% limits, Kobe probabilities, the priors used and the links to their sources), series (by year: catch, predicted catch, B/k, biomass, B/Bmsy, F and F/Fmsy, with 95% limits), kobe (the last-year draws), details (per stock: posterior draws of r, k and B/k, the priors, retrospective runs), logs, sources (the versions of CMSY++, JAGS, R and the data) and changes (the changes made to the CMSY++ code). The summary is saved in tables/cmsy/.

详细说明

每个种群在out_dir下各自的文件夹中、在单独的R进程中运行，使用一份针对本机修改过的代码副本（见cmsy_system()：按照用户指南为macOS和Linux修改windows()和antialias，并去掉依赖RStudio的代码、已从CRAN存档的snpar包和自动安装包的代码）。这些文件夹保留CMSY++的原始输出（cmsy_output.csv、JPEG图表和日志），便于逐一核查每个结果。

FAO数据没有资源丰度指数，因此只运行CMSY++中仅基于渔获量的部分。FAO（2026）的全球评估将CMSY++列为第3级（Tier 3，数据有限）方法之一；按照其做法，状态只分为两类：最大可持续捕捞（“maximally sustainably fished”，最后一年B/Bmsy至少为0.8）或过度捕捞（“overfished”，B/Bmsy低于0.8）；仅基于渔获量的结果不用于将种群判定为低度捕捞。

English

Each stock runs in its own folder under out_dir and in a separate R process, with a copy of the code changed for this computer (see cmsy_system(): the windows() and antialias changes of the user guide for macOS and Linux, and removing RStudio, the archived snpar package and the automatic package installation). The folders keep the original CMSY++ output (cmsy_output.csv, the JPEG charts and the log), so each result can be checked.

Since FAO data have no abundance index, only the catch-only part of CMSY++ runs. Following FAO (2026), whose global review uses CMSY++ among its Tier 3 (data-limited) methods, the status is given in two classes only: “maximally sustainably fished” (B/Bmsy at least 0.8 in the last year) or “overfished” (B/Bmsy below 0.8); catch-only results are not used to call a stock underfished.

参考文献

Froese, R., Winker, H., Coro, G., et al. (2023). New developments in the analysis of catch time series as the basis for fish stock assessments: the CMSY++ method. Acta Ichthyologica et Piscatoria 53: 173-189. doi:10.3897/aiep.53.105910

FAO (2026). The State of World Fisheries and Aquaculture 2026. Rome, FAO. Section “The status of fishery resources”, Box 1.3 (assessment tiers and status classes). https://openknowledge.fao.org/server/api/core/bitstreams/09d03e2f-7097-4d59-bf94-db65e95f44fd/content/sofia-2026/the-status-fishery-resources.html

示例 

cmsy_setup()                                       # once
FAO34 <- fishing_area_data("Atlantic, Eastern Central", plot = FALSE)
input <- cmsy_input(FAO34$area_data)

# Bigeye grunt, with the start year suggested by CMSY++ and a fixed seed
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "Brachydeuterus auritus", auto_start = TRUE, seed = 1)
result$summary[, c("Stock", "first_year", "B_Bmsy", "B_Bmsy_lcl", "B_Bmsy_ucl", "F_Fmsy", "status")]
head(result$series)                                # catch, B/k, biomass, B/Bmsy, F/Fmsy by year

# Every CMSY++ chart of the user guide, including the retrospective analysis
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1, auto_start = TRUE,
                   plots = c("analysis", "management", "kobe", "prior_posterior", "retrospective"))

# Changed CMSY++ settings (see cmsy_defaults()): longer chains and a larger process error
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", seed = 1,
                   settings = list(n.iter = 100000, n.burnin = 50000, sigmaR = 0.15))
result$settings[result$settings$changed, c("setting", "cmsy_default", "used")]

# The ten main stocks, four at a time, without progress bar or messages
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = input$stocks$Stock[1:10], parallel = 4, silent = TRUE)

# Settings that would be used on Windows, and charts in the system's own windows
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", os = "windows")
result <- cmsy_run(input, stocks = "GRB_34", device = "screen")

# Versions and links of everything used, for the methods section of a report
result$sources
